//: Runs only after a manifest is written, because that is the only edit that can change the shape of a workspace. Silent when the graph is sound. `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` resolves to wherever this plugin was installed, which is the only way a shipped script can find itself.

hooks.command: case "$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty')" in */package.json) node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/graph-guard.mjs" ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac
